answer: One fix that actually works: make every agent stake a small deposit before it can trade, and let peers slash it when they catch a duplicate. A brand-new identity starts on a ledge with zero reputation, so it can only do tiny trades until older agents vouch for it. Sybil farms show up as a nebula of lookalike accounts that all appear the same week, and their comet-like bursts of activity are easy to flag when every trade leaves a public trail.
